items.h: Shows off big leg, tackling prowess in loss
items.s: Slye made all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also logged a tackle and forced a fumble. Slye connected on field goals from 53, 54 and 50 yards during Sunday's loss, and he's now up to four makes from 50-plus yards on the year. He also made his way onto the highlight reel with a big tackle on a kickoff that forced the ball out of Josh Cameron's arms, although the Jaguars were able to recover the fumble. items.h: Joey Slye goes for 11 kicking points in loss
items.s: Joey Slye hit both of his PATs and all three of his field goal attempts in the Titans' 40-23 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. After being stuck on a struggling offense, Slye now has 14, 6, 8, and 11 kicking points in his last four games. He's starting to be a little more usable for fantasy, but the Titans' recent history still looms large over those who want to start him.

items.h: Makes all four kicks in defeat
items.s: Slye hit both field-goal tries and his only two extra-point attempts in Sunday's 43-36 loss to the Bengals. The kicker drilled field goals from 46 and 29 yards out, respectively. Slye has only missed one kick this year, a field goal, but the Titans' offense has not been consistent enough to give him ample opportunities on a weekly basis.

items.h: Joey Slye makes two FGs in Week 8
items.s: Joey Slye made both of his field-goal attempts and added two extra points in a 43-36 overtime loss to the Bengals in Week 8. Slye hit field goals from 46 and 29 yards out in the wild loss to Cincinnati. The veteran kicker has made 12 of 13 field-goal attempts and added 12 extra points this season. He will be on bye in Week 9.

items.h: Joey Slye makes one FG in Week 7
items.s: Joey Slye made his lone field-goal attempt and added three extra points in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7. Slye made his lone attempt, a 29-yarder, to tie the game at 17-17 in the fourth quarter. The veteran kicker has made 10 of his 11 field-goal tries this season. He will kick against the Bengals in Week 8.

Slye made his only field-goal attempt while going 3-for-3 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns. Slye made the most of his only field-goal try in Week 7, splitting the uprights on a 29-yarder in the fourth quarter. The kicker has now converted one or zero field-goal attempts in five of seven contests to open the 2026 campaign, and he'll continue to be an unpredictable fantasy option moving forward.

items.h: Makes four field goals in win
items.s: Slye went 4-for-4 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs during Sunday's 26-20 win over the Colts. Slye was able to make multiple field goals in a contest for the second time this season and first time since Week 2. The kicker converted attempts from 29 and 56 yards in the third quarter before adding makes from 49 and 44 yards in the fourth. Slye has now gone 9-for-10 on field-goal attempts, including 1-for-2 from 50-plus yards, while making all seven of his extra-point tries over six contests to open the 2026 campaign.

items.h: Joey Slye has big game in win over Colts
items.s: Joey Slye hit all four of his field goal attempts and both of his PATs in the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday. Slye was able to get a bunch of points thanks to the Titans' offense being uable to find paydirt for most of the afternoon. The defense was also able to offer short fields to the offense as well, furthering Slye's chances of racking up points. He's an iffy start on a team that has struggled so much to score, but maybe they can build off of this and become interesting.

Slye made his lone field-goal attempt during the Titans' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Sunday. Slye converted on a 30-yard chip shot to end the Titans' opening offensive drive, but that ended being his only attempt of the game. He's attempted one or zero field goals in four of the first five games of the regular season, and his scoring floor is the lowest of all kickers given that the Titans score just 11.6 points per game, which is dead last in the NFL. Tennessee hits the road for Week 6 against Indianapolis on Oct. 18.

items.h: Joey Slye makes lone field goal Sunday
items.s: Joey Slye made his lone field goal on Sunday. Slye is not reliable for fantasy managers on the Titans offense.
